name: DropChat
summary: Chat with the AI model of your choice from the notch
description:
DropChat puts a chat with a large language model on Droppy's shelf, and optionally in a floating window that stays above full-screen apps.

Bring your own key for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, OpenRouter or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Connect MCP servers for tools, point DropChat at a folder of agent skills, and turn on web search and page reading with an Exa or Perplexity key. Attach files, drop them on the chat, or pull in whatever is selected in Finder.

Keys stay in your Keychain. Every tool that can change something asks before it runs.
